summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: At the Pentagon, OpenAI is In and Anthropic Is Out
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: The Case for Why Better Breach Transparency Matters
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 11 articles published in the last 24 hours
